import { test } from "@playwright/test";

const OUT = process.env.CAPTURE_OUT!;
const LABEL = process.env.CAPTURE_LABEL!; // main | head
const total = 37;
const card = (i: number) => ({
  kind: "news",
  id: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(i + 1).padStart(12, "0")}`,
  title: `Материал ленты ${String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  publishedAt: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 27, 9) - i * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
  image: null,
  source: { platform: "academy", name: "Академия" },
  partner: null,
  href: `/materials/feed-${i + 1}`,
});

for (const { w, h } of [{ w: 1440, h: 1300 }, { w: 390, h: 844 }])
  for (const theme of ["light", "dark"] as const)
    test(`${w} ${theme}`, async ({ page }) => {
      await page.route((u) => u.pathname === "/v1/public/feed", async (route) => {
        const url = new URL(route.request().url());
        const from = Number(url.searchParams.get("cursor") ?? "0");
        const limit = Number(url.searchParams.get("limit"));
        const to = Math.min(total, from + limit);
        if (from > 0) await new Promise((d) => setTimeout(d, 250));
        await route.fulfill({
          json: {
            data: Array.from({ length: to - from }, (_, i) => card(from + i)),
            nextCursor: to < total ? String(to) : null,
          },
        });
      });
      // Deterministic #4230 race: right after a later page's JSON lands (the
      // rail's handler runs a few microtasks later), and before React's
      // scheduled re-render, one scroll frame reaches the rail.
      await page.addInitScript(() => {
        const orig = window.fetch.bind(window);
        window.fetch = async (input, init) => {
          const res = await orig(input, init);
          const u = String(input instanceof Request ? input.url : input);
          if (!u.includes("/v1/public/feed") || !u.includes("cursor=")) return res;
          const json = res.json.bind(res);
          res.json = async () => {
            const data = await json();
            let p = Promise.resolve();
            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) p = p.then(() => undefined);
            void p.then(() =>
              document
                .querySelector('[role="region"][aria-label*="листайте"]')
                ?.dispatchEvent(new Event("scroll")),
            );
            return data;
          };
          return res;
        };
      });
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: w, height: h });
      await page.emulateMedia({ colorScheme: theme });
      await page.goto("/");
      await page.evaluate((t) => document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", t === "dark"), theme);
      const rail = page.getByRole("region", { name: /листайте/ });
      await rail.locator("[data-slot] > a").first().waitFor();
      await rail.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      const next = page.getByRole("button", { name: "Дальше, к более ранним материалам" });
      const idle = () =>
        page.waitForFunction(
          () => document.querySelector('[role="region"][aria-label*="листайте"]')?.getAttribute("aria-busy") !== "true",
        );
      // Page to the end: → on desktop, swipe-like scroll to the end on a phone.
      for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        if (w > 600) {
          if (!(await next.isEnabled())) break;
          await next.click();
        } else {
          const done = await rail.evaluate((el) => {
            const end = el.scrollLeft >= el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth - 4;
            el.scrollTo({ left: el.scrollWidth, behavior: "auto" });
            return end && el.getAttribute("aria-busy") !== "true";
          });
          if (done) break;
        }
        await page.waitForTimeout(700);
        await idle();
      }
      await page.waitForTimeout(800);
      const titles = await rail.locator("[data-slot] > a").evaluateAll((as) =>
        as.map((a) => (a.textContent ?? "").match(/Материал ленты (\d{2})/)?.[1] ?? "?"),
      );
      const dupes = titles.filter((t, i) => titles.indexOf(t) !== i);
      console.log(`CAPTURE ${LABEL} ${w} ${theme}: cards=${titles.length} duplicates=${dupes.length} [${[...new Set(dupes)].join(",")}]`);
      // Bring the first duplicated card (or the end) into view for the shot.
      if (dupes.length)
        await rail.evaluate((el, n) => {
          const as = [...el.querySelectorAll("[data-slot] > a")];
          const seen = new Set<string>();
          for (const a of as) {
            const t = (a.textContent ?? "").match(/Материал ленты (\d{2})/)?.[1] ?? "";
            if (seen.has(t)) {
              const slot = a.parentElement as HTMLElement;
              // The first repeated card sits at the left edge, its first copy
              // one rail-width earlier, so both copies show in one shot.
              el.style.scrollSnapType = "none";
              el.scrollLeft += slot.getBoundingClientRect().left - el.getBoundingClientRect().left - el.clientWidth / 2;
              return;
            }
            seen.add(t);
          }
        }, 0);
      else
        await rail.evaluate((el) => el.scrollTo({ left: el.scrollWidth, behavior: "auto" }));
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      console.log("POS", JSON.stringify(await rail.evaluate((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { l: el.scrollLeft, max: el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth, w: el.clientWidth, seen: [...el.querySelectorAll("[data-slot] > a")].filter((a) => { const b = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.right > r.left && b.left < r.right; }).map((a) => (a.textContent ?? "").match(/ленты (\d{2})/)?.[1]) }; })));
      const section = rail.locator("xpath=ancestor::section[1]");
      await (await section.count() ? section : rail).screenshot({
        path: `${OUT}/${LABEL}-feed-rail-paged-${w}-${theme}.png`,
        animations: "disabled",
      });
    });
